observations: Photo 0: A white industrial sewing machine on a white surface, with a metal stand and a power cord visible. The machine appears to be in used condition with some wear.

Photo 1: Same machine from a slightly different angle, showing the front and side. The machine has a metal plate with a red oval logo and the word 'Emel' inside it. The needle and presser foot are visible.
Photo 2: The machine is placed on a wooden table with a metal stand. Below the machine, a motor is visible, connected by a chain. The table and stand show signs of wear and paint chipping.

Photo 3: Front view of the machine on the table. The 'Emel' logo is clearly visible on the side. The machine has a large bobbin case and a handwheel on the right side. The surface is white, possibly a tablecloth or sheet.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI I BUY I SELL'.

claims.evidence: The machine is an industrial sewing machine with a straight stitch needle, as seen in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 3. The design and components (motor, stand, table) are consistent with an industrial model.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the motor running and the needle moving up and down.

risks.risk: Missing parts or accessories (e.g., foot pedal, bobbins, needles)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues or damaged wiring
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the power cord and plug, showing no fraying or damage, and a video of the machine being turned on.
risks.if_unproven: priced with reduced value due to potential safety hazard

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, showing the motor running and needle moving.
Photo of all included accessories (foot pedal, bobbins, needles, etc.).
Close-up of the power cord and plug, showing no damage.
Photo of the machine's serial number or model plate, if any.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
